CustomField.description: Date the commissioning was notified to the Bundesnetzagentur. LSV § 4 Abs. 1 requires it within two weeks; decommissioning and a change of operator must be notified unverzueglich, and on a change of operator BOTH the old and the new operator notify. § 6 LSV then forwards the register data monthly to the Land metrology authorities, so this entry is not a private act.
